name: Band Ankle Plantarflexion

rehabilitation.clinical_protocol: Cornell Health Physical Therapy Ankle Protocol

steps: Sit on the floor with your leg straight and hold the ends of a resistance band in both hands.
Loop the middle of the band around the ball of your foot, keeping tension with your hands.
Begin with your ankle flexed back toward your body.
Point your foot and toes forward away from you like pressing a gas pedal, pushing against the band.
Pause at peak extension for one second, then slowly return your foot to the flexed starting position.
coaching_cues: Push firmly through the ball of your foot rather than curling just your toes.
Maintain steady resistance with your arms without letting your elbows move.
Perform smoothly and steadily without jerky bounces.

sources.attribution: Cornell Health Physical Therapy Exercise Protocol
